meta.name: widgets-ui
meta.description: Declarative UI widgets from JSON for React/Next.js from ui.inference.sh. Render rich interactive UIs from structured agent responses. Capabilities: forms, buttons, cards, layouts, inputs, selects, checkboxes. Use for: agent-generated UIs, dynamic forms, data display, interactive cards. Triggers: widgets, declarative ui, json ui, widget renderer, agent widgets, dynamic ui, form widgets, card widgets, shadcn widgets, structured output ui

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用 JSON 声明式生成 React 交互界面
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在 React 应用中通过 JSON 快速渲染 UI 组件
copy.tagline_en: Render React UIs declaratively from JSON
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly render UI components from JSON in React apps

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 可以根据 JSON 数据生成交互式 UI 组件，比如表单、按钮、卡片、输入框等，并处理用户的点击或提交操作。
howto.when: 当你要求 Claude 生成动态 UI、表单或数据展示卡片，或者提到“widgets”、“declarative ui”、“json ui”等关键词时触发。

say.text: 帮我生成一个联系表单，包含姓名、邮箱和留言输入框。
say.note: Claude 会输出一个可提交的表单 UI。

say.text: 创建一个航班信息卡片，显示从SFO到JFK的航班。
say.note: Claude 会渲染一个带渐变背景的航班卡片。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can generate interactive UI components from JSON, such as forms, buttons, cards, inputs, etc., and handle user clicks or submissions.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask Claude to generate dynamic UI, forms, or data display cards, or mention keywords like "widgets", "declarative ui", "json ui".

say_en.text: Generate a contact form with name, email, and message fields.
say_en.note: Claude will output a submittable form UI.

say_en.text: Create a flight info card showing a flight from SFO to JFK.
say_en.note: Claude will render a flight card with gradient background.
